persona.name: Domi Jin
persona.headline: Scientist. Builder. Founder.
persona.tagline: A sci-fi mind. An engineer’s hands.
persona.mission: Exploring how technology can expand human potential and empower people to achieve more together.
persona.centralQuestion: How can we use technology to help individuals become more capable and enable people to collaborate more effectively?

background.summary: My journey began with fundamental science, studying the universe through computational astrophysics, numerical simulations, and statistical modeling.
background.evidence: Conducted 3,140 numerical simulations (>100 TB, 25,000+ node-hours on TACC supercomputers) of 1M-body globular clusters using N-body O(N^3) and Monte Carlo O(N log N) methods, extracting a 17M x 14 database of binary black holes to evaluate gravitational wave signals for ESA's space-borne LISA detector.

background.summary: I subsequently moved into applied machine learning, building decision systems for consumer products, marketplaces, and advertising technology.
background.evidence: Built context-extraction and recommendation engines from real-time mobility telemetry, marketplace pricing and generative AI request workflows, and deep-learning performance advertising evaluation, causal attribution, and demand-mining architectures.

background.summary: Entrepreneurship brought a different perspective: understanding what people actually need, how they make decisions, and why technically promising solutions sometimes fail in the real world.
background.evidence: Founder of Kin Domi, Inc. and creator of open-source research protocols (Open Learning Lab, baby-AI, Life Hack iMessage Router, LibertyEarth) focused on human agency, verifiable edge intelligence, and collective coordination.

philosophy.coreBelief: I believe humanity’s greatest achievements emerge through collaboration. Intelligence matters, but so do communication, trust, complementary capabilities, incentives, and the freedom to make meaningful choices.
philosophy.valueMeasure: Technology is a means rather than an end. Its value should ultimately be measured by how it improves people’s opportunities, autonomy, relationships, and quality of life.
philosophy.methodology: My approach combines scientific curiosity with practical experimentation: challenge assumptions, build working systems, measure outcomes, learn from failure, and revise our understanding.
philosophy.epistemicNote: My intellectual interests represent continuing explorations and engineering hypotheses, not claims of completed research or established scientific findings.

lookingFor.summary: I enjoy working with intellectually curious people who combine ambitious questions with rigorous thinking and practical execution.
stakeholders: Lead AI Teams & Research Labs (Human-AI Collaboration, Agentic Control Planes, Edge/Personal Memory, Post-Training & Evaluation)
Founder-Centric Investors & Visionaries (Long-horizon thesis alignment, human-centered AI, collective intelligence)
Interdisciplinary Builders & Researchers (Complex adaptive systems, decision intelligence, durable learning policies)

writings.title: Open Learning Lab: Evidence-Driven Personalized Learning Policies
writings.summary: An open research ledger testing which LLM-mediated learning policies produce durable, transferable capability per unit of learner effort outside the tutoring session.
writings.keyInsight: Asking a learner to make the underlying design judgment before revealing how an expert system solved the problem improves reconstruction and transfer compared with explanation-first tutoring.

writings.title: baby-AI: Receipt-Verified Edge Household Agent Architecture
writings.summary: Five falsifiable subsystem specs (perception, streaming ASR + DoA, hybrid episodic-vector + KG memory, edge VLM verbal-feedback adapter, cryptographic eval receipts) on <$200 hardware.
writings.keyInsight: Code is the means; cryptographically signed evaluation receipts on named benchmarks are the trust contract—enabling privacy-preserving personal AI that learns verbally on-device.

writings.title: Life Hack: iMessage as a Low-Bandwidth Router to the Internet
writings.summary: A minimalist HCI harness turning constrained messaging pipes (in-flight Wi-Fi, satellite text) into a universal command line for internet-connected reasoning agents.
writings.keyInsight: Before neural links, the most resilient interface for everyday agents is the asynchronous, interruptible messaging pipe already in your pocket.

writings.title: Reclaiming Play as a Life Skill
writings.summary: Examines Jane McGonigal's game mechanics (goals, rules, feedback systems, voluntary participation) through conversations with senior learners and retirees.
writings.keyInsight: Lifelong learning, health management, and technological exploration are high-order 'social games'—embracing clarity, feedback, and voluntary challenge keeps people in flow across every stage of life.

writings.title: Tesla, Seniors Love Your Self-Driving—Now Let’s Make It Safer for Them
writings.summary: Field observations from Kin Domi showing how autonomous driving restores senior independence, paired with 6 concrete HCI and safety engineering recommendations.
writings.keyInsight: Panic-inducing alerts and touchscreen menus degrade safety for older drivers; delaying non-urgent alerts, adding pre-drive diagnostics, and prioritizing voice control directly bridge the human-AI trust gap.

writings.title: Overachiever’s Responsibility: Leadership, Alignment, and Sustainable Growth
writings.summary: A mathematical and operational reflection on how founders can build enduring teams without operational burnout.
writings.keyInsight: High-performing teams maximize both their Greatest Common Divisor (shared values that minimize communication friction) and Least Common Multiple (complementary capabilities that expand collective reach), while putting incentives before expectations.

writings.title: A Colorful Year Ahead: Milestones & Momentum from Intentional Rhythm
writings.summary: Open-sources an 8th-iteration operational work model combining shared calendar transparency, fractional asynchronous collaboration, and structured weekly reflection.
writings.keyInsight: Sharing calendars for inclusion and enabling fractional, asynchronous contributions reduces coordination overhead while respecting natural human rhythms.

writings.title: Agent-Based Advertising System & Observations in Performance Advertising
writings.summary: Technical specification for an 8-agent control plane operating alongside a sub-50ms p99 SOTA ad serving fast path, paired with an economic analysis of scaling laws in performance advertising.
writings.keyInsight: Decoupling the sub-50ms inference fast path from an asynchronous multi-agent control plane (campaign, creative, pacing, bidding, retention, safety, experimentation) shifts digital systems from reactive clicks to long-term demand realization.

writings.title: Serendipity: Where It Sparks & Dedication: Where It Is Channeled
writings.summary: Personal synthesis of how astrophysics timescales, Confucian ethics, and interdisciplinary exploration connect disparate domain peaks into a unified highland.
writings.keyInsight: Standing on the shoulders of giants is not enough; connecting the peaks across physics, machine learning, and human-computer interaction builds an intellectual highland from which new solutions emerge.

writings.title: Starting a New Venture & Momentum in Human-Centered Elder AI
writings.summary: Chronicles the zero-to-one customer discovery, ethical community outreach, and multidisciplinary team formation behind Kin Domi, Inc.
writings.keyInsight: Beneath technical barriers like smartphone dexterity lie deeper human needs for autonomy, dignity, and intergenerational connection—requiring field empathy before code.

writings.title: Reflections from a Coach-Seeking Impulse
writings.summary: Examines the mechanics of coaching, intellectual honesty, and why shared context determines the effectiveness of feedback.
writings.keyInsight: Coaching is guided self-reflection; its effectiveness is bounded by intellectual honesty and the density of shared context between partners.

writings.title: Building Proactive Personal AI Memory (Third Ear / TwinMind AMA)
writings.summary: Architectural discussion on platform-agnostic personal AI memory combining edge voice processing, query-rewriting privacy, and visual browser context.
writings.keyInsight: Generic AI fails because it lacks personal context; hybrid edge-cloud memory with identifier stripping reduces API costs by 20x while preserving user privacy.

writings.title: Is Dark Mode Doing More Harm Than Good? A Deeper Look at Our Choices
writings.summary: Uses the visual ergonomics of dark mode as a case study to critique short-term agile feature shipping versus long-term user welfare.
writings.keyInsight: Agile iteration reduces launch risk but systematically underweights long-term externalities unless paired with first-principles research and adaptive user onboarding.

writings.title: Trace of AppLovin’s 7x Annual Hypergrowth & The Growth Trap
writings.summary: Dissects how cross-domain behavioral data, scaling laws, and latency tolerance drove hypergrowth in ad tech, and why surveillance capitalism hits diminishing returns.
writings.keyInsight: While scaling laws reward denser behavioral context, demand-driven markets inevitably face consumer fatigue and escalating social costs unless technology shifts toward user enlightenment.

writings.title: Rethinking Digital Advertising: Demand Mining & Dynamic Personalization
writings.summary: Proposes replacing binary click optimization with multi-stage intent graphs, compact profile distillation, and user-controlled 'ad shuffling' UX.
writings.keyInsight: Giving users active agency (such as shuffling creatives in-slot) transforms passive impressions into high-signal preference feedback.

writings.title: From Traffic Lights to Life’s Direction: Crowdsourced Inference & Symbolic AI
writings.summary: Reverse-engineers how navigation apps predict traffic light countdowns via crowdsourced probe trajectories rather than hardware sensors, alongside reflections from Wolfram Summer School.
writings.keyInsight: Emergent statistical inference over crowdsourced trajectories can replicate expensive physical infrastructure—while combining LLMs (memory) with symbolic computation (Wolfram) bridges correlation and causal reasoning.

writings.title: Why Is Some Professional Handwriting Illegible? Information Bandwidth & HCI
writings.summary: First-principles exploration of medical documentation bottlenecks, human speech transmission rates (~39 bits/sec), and institutional information barriers.
writings.keyInsight: When human output bandwidth is constrained in high-stress environments, voice-first HCI and ambient capture solve the root bottleneck better than post-hoc OCR.

writings.title: All About ChatGPT: Flat Correlation, Unit Economics & Alignment
writings.summary: Analyzes search engine margin disruption, feed-forward computational flatness vs. symbolic loops, RLHF selection bias, and collective knowledge graphs.
writings.keyInsight: Flat token correlation is the foundation of knowledge, not causality—and alignment is an ongoing organizational governance problem that cannot be solved behind closed doors.

writings.title: Free Market in a Possibility Universe & The Collaborative Manifesto
writings.summary: Explores information asymmetry, resource coordination among autonomous agents, and liquid democracy in high-entropy social systems.
writings.keyInsight: Overcoming human biological limits in information I/O and processing requires new social contracts that align individual ownership with collective decision-making.

writings.title: Gravitational Waves from Binary Black Holes in Globular Clusters & Open Research Workflow
writings.summary: Ph.D. dissertation modeling 1M-body globular clusters across 3,140 supercomputer simulations (100+ TB) and establishing reproducible Jupyter-based open science workflows.
writings.keyInsight: Simulating emergent multi-body dynamics from first principles—and making the entire computational pipeline reproducible—creates the methodological foundation for modeling complex human and AI systems.
